exposure: hospitalisations for acute respiratory tract infection (ARTI) in the first year of life
Hospitalisations for acute respiratory tract infection (ARTI) in the first year of life
cohort: 32,333 Aboriginal children born 2003-2012 in Western Australia
finding: Hospitalization for ARTI, area-level disadvantage, preterm birth, and low birth weight were significant risk factors for asthma in Aboriginal children, with ARTI alone accounting for 31% of asthma cases.
